Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. Our dashboard did show transfer TRF-INV-88 as failed, but I asked Access Bank for the final status and they confirm the payment went through successfully.

Details of the credit:
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Recipient: Access Bank, account 0234567891
- Credited: 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Please check your account statement for that date. If you can't see it, take the session ID above to your bank branch and they can trace the credit directly.

I have not resent the payment, since the bank confirms the original one landed — sending a second ₦250,000 would mean a double payment we'd both have to claw back. If the funds genuinely don't show in your account after you've traced it with the session ID, let me know and we'll take it from there.

Best regards,
Operations Assistant, Mama's Kitchen

[after the person answered]

Good afternoon Chidi,

I understand this is frustrating, but I'm not able to resend the payment. Access Bank has given us their final confirmation — not just our dashboard — that the ₦250,000 was credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC, under bank session ID 000014261121140211000088. Their record is authoritative, and sending a second payment against it would be a duplicate.

At this point the funds have left us and are sitting with your bank, so the next step is on their side. Please visit your Access Bank branch (or call their customer line) and ask them to trace the credit using the details below:

- Amount: ₦250,000
- Date: 21 November 2026, credited 14:02 UTC (15:02 Nigerian time)
- Session ID: 000014261121140211000088
- Account: 0234567891

A bank trace will locate the credit and show where it is — sometimes it sits in a suspense or uncredited account until the account details or name matching are corrected by the bank itself. Once your bank corrects that on their end, the money will land in your account; no new payment from us is needed.

If your bank tells you the funds were returned to us or genuinely never landed, ask them for that in writing and send it over — we'll pick it up immediately from there.

Best regards,
Operations Assistant, Mama's Kitchen
